items.title: A criterion for birationality of integral schemes via residue fields of generic points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives three equivalent formulations of birationality for integral schemes locally of finite type over a base: being birational, admitting nonempty isomorphic opens, and having generic points over the same point of the base with isomorphic residue field extensions. The proof quotes the equivalence of the first two, notes the immediate implication, and then, assuming the third, identifies the local rings at the generic points with the residue fields and applies the rational-map existence result and the birational-morphism criterion to close the cycle.
